text: まー　ええわ　おむかえの　ふねも　まだやし　そこの　ポケモンセンターで　まっとくから　てが　あいたら　きたって！

structure.jp: おむかえの　ふねも　まだやし
structure.en: the boat picking me up isn't here yet anyway, and

structure.jp: そこの　ポケモンセンターで　まっとくから
structure.en: I'll be waiting at the Pokémon Center there, so

patterns.name: 〜ておく
patterns.explanation: ておく means doing something ahead of time and leaving it that way; とく is the short spoken form. まっとく = 'I'll be waiting (until then)'.

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: きたって is Kansai dialect for きてやって, 'do me the favor of coming', a friendly way to ask. きたって = 'come by, will you'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し after a statement gives it as one reason, like 'and anyway'; や is Kansai dialect for だ. まだやし = 'it's not here yet anyway'.
